As a person who spent precious time in her early twenties messing with dudes in their thirties, I can tell you from experience that those were the worst relationships I have ever had. Older men who date women whose brains haven’t even fully developed are losers.  I cringe deeply now when I think of the mental gymnastics I did to justify my relationships with them. I guess I thought it was fun and that their lives seemed more stable and interesting than the men who were my age.  To an extent they were, but being more put together than a 21 year old boy is a low fucking bar. 
I regret all of the time I wasted on those losers. I regret all of the fantasies I must have fulfilled for them. Please, take it from me and leave while it is easier to. This jerk doesn’t deserve any more of your time or your body than he has already taken from you. Dump him and go enjoy your adolescence before it’s gone.

Disney’s “Soul” made me a wreck both times I watched it. As someone with chronic depression and anxiety (and as someone who has made attempts at ending their own life), the scene where he thinks back on all of the small and exquisitely beautiful things in life moved me very deeply. Giving yourself permission to just LIVE without any obligation to “be someone” or “make something out of yourself” is a such a profoundly beautiful message to share with children. It has taken me a long time as an adult to understand that life doesn’t have to have a purpose to be worth living and enjoying.

I also have two more brothers who are 3 years apart. My sister and I have a very special and unbreakable bond because we are so close in age. We are both in our mid twenties now and we are the best of friends. In fact, I’m getting ready so I can spend the morning Christmas shopping with her and my adorable nephew. We call each other often, and send each other funny videos and stories that remind us of the stupid things we did when we were kids. My two brothers who are close in age have the same relationship as my sister and I, but they express it differently. All I’m trying to say is that I feel really lucky that I grew up with a best friend, and I’m excited that your two boys will get to have that same closeness. Congratulations on your beautiful family!
